summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier) and SHACLPathError (direct Exception subclass). Added test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with a parametrized test plus None and plain-string tests. The new tests and the existing test/test_path.py pass (41 passed) using the prepared venv. Nothing committed. Deviations: an explicit isinstance(path_identifier, Node) guard is added so None is not treated as a wildcard. mypy, black, and isort are not installed in the venv, so type checking and formatting were verified by reading only; the URIRef / URIRef expressions in the tests have no type-ignore and may be flagged by mypy.
